product_title: Handcrafted Teal Rope Floral Tealight Holder Set
product_description: Add a refreshing touch to your festive decor with this handcrafted set featuring a teal braided base, elegant pearl borders, rich red roses, and golden tealight holders. Perfect for Diwali, pooja decor, and festive table styling.
product_care_suggestion: Clean gently with a soft, dry cloth.
Keep flowers and pearl embellishments away from direct heat.
Use LED tealights for safer lighting around floral decorations.
Store in a dry, protective box when not in use.
